sloka: अयोध्या ऽपि पुरी रम्या शून्या वर्षगणान्बहून् ।ऋषभं प्राप्य राजानं निवासमुपयास्यति ।। ७.१११.९ ॥
transliteration: ayodhyā 'pi purī ramyā śūnyā varṣagaṇānbahūn ।ṛṣabhaṁ prāpya rājānaṁ nivāsamupayāsyati ।। 7.111.9 ॥

translations.english: The beautiful city of Ayodhya, which has been deserted for many years, will once again become inhabited when King Rishabha takes the throne.
